case.question: My manager wants to comp a $40 meal for a complaint. Can she?

trace.question: My manager wants to comp a $40 meal for a complaint. Can she?
trace.answer:
No, not on her own. Under [house: Comps], a manager can comp up to $25 on a single ticket to resolve a complaint about food quality or a long wait. A $40 comp is above that limit, so the owner has to approve it. The policy says you can be reached by text during service.

Two other rules apply. Comps for friends, family, or staff aren't allowed at any amount. Total comps in a week should also stay under 1% of that week's gross sales.

She could comp up to $25 herself. The full $40 needs your approval.

case.question: How long do we have to dispute a missing-item chargeback on an Uber Eats order?

trace.question: How long do we have to dispute a missing-item chargeback on an Uber Eats order?
trace.answer:
You have 30 days from the order date to dispute a missing-item chargeback on an Uber Eats order. A dispute filed after that is rejected automatically [marketplace: Missing or incorrect items].

You also need a packing photo showing the item in the bag. Photos are taken at the pass for every marketplace order over $40. If an order was over $40 and has no photo, don't dispute it. Accept the chargeback and log it as a packing miss.

case.question: Can we send a promotional text at 10pm?

found: messaging: Who may receive marketing texts

trace.question: Can we send a promotional text at 10pm?
trace.answer:
No. Our quiet-hours rule says no text of any kind goes out between 8pm and 9am in the customer's local time [messaging: Quiet hours]. If we don't know a customer's local time, we use Central time. A 10pm send would break that rule for any customer. The earliest compliant time is 9am, and the last is just before 8pm, in each customer's local time.

A promotional text also has other conditions:
- It can only go to customers with verified SMS consent. Implied consent isn't enough [messaging: Who may receive marketing texts].
- Anyone who has unsubscribed can't be texted at all [messaging: Who may receive marketing texts].
- No customer gets more than four marketing texts in a calendar month [messaging: Frequency].
- A discount can't exceed 15% or $10, whichever is lower, unless you approve it. The offer must also show an expiry date within 14 days and say "one per customer" [messaging: Offers in messages].

I can draft a campaign for a daytime send if you'd like. You would approve it before anything goes out.

case.question: A customer wants to cancel a catering order three days before pickup. Do they get the deposit back?

trace.question: A customer wants to cancel a catering order three days before pickup. Do they get the deposit back?
trace.answer:
Yes. Under the house catering policy, the deposit is refundable up to 48 hours before pickup and kept after that [house: Catering]. A cancellation three days (72 hours) before pickup is inside that window, so the customer gets the deposit back.

The cancellation has to be made at least 48 hours before pickup. If the customer waits more than a day, they'll fall inside the 48-hour cutoff and lose the deposit.
